name: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration vol.2
source:
Self-proclaimed filmmaker Blue Hawaii Aniki is back on the radio!

Egged on by his wisecracking scriptwriter Bonto Taira, Aniki tackles his second recording session alongside veteran FM DJ Cathy Koiwai.

This episode's main dish: "Goddess of Vocation."

Masterminded by ace career consultant Megumi Kuri, the training session takes place in the middle of a sweet potato field. Seven fresh recruits from major sauce manufacturer Next Source Co., Ltd. are thrown headfirst into a mysterious exercise: "dig up your best memories."

For Urara Ueda — a new hire in HR who has kept her distance from her colleagues since day one — this turns out to be an unexpected autumn afternoon.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4580350/Blue_Hawaii_Anikis_Small_Celebration_vol2/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
自称为电影制作人的蓝色夏威夷阿尼基 (Blue Hawaii Aniki) 重返广播电台！

在爱说俏皮话的编剧Bonto Taira的怂恿下，Aniki与资深FM DJ Cathy Koiwai一起进行了第二次录音。

本期主菜：《职业女神》。

培训课程由王牌职业顾问栗惠美 (Megumi Kuri) 策划，在红薯地中央进行。来自大型酱料制造商Next Source Co., Ltd. 的七名新员工被投入一项神秘的练习：“挖掘你最美好的回忆”。

对于人力资源部门的新员工Urara Ueda来说，从第一天起她就与同事保持着距离。对于她来说，这是一个意想不到的秋天下午。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4580350/Blue_Hawaii_Anikis_Small_Celebration_vol2/]Steam[/url]]
